description: Governance policy for Aeostara as a downstream ASH-based conformance and execution-spec repository.

rules.name: ASH Upstream Authority
rules.description: ASH semantic specifications are immutable upstream authority. Aeostara must not redefine semantic truth for validity, classification, recoverability, fallback, containment, or safe halt.

rules.name: Diagnosis-First Semantics
rules.description: Top-level flow must be diagnosis/classification/recoverability-first. Surface-difference evidence must be produced inside the ASH-aligned flow.

rules.name: Recoverability-Driven Planning
rules.description: Recovery planning must derive from ASH-aligned state class and recoverability category; CRUD action lists cannot be top-level semantic authority.

rules.name: Escalation Envelope Completeness
rules.description: Fallback, containment, and safe-halt pathways must be explicit and deterministic.

rules.name: Policy and Safety Gates
rules.description: Policy gating, backup, verification, rollback, and audit are mandatory execution constraints for mutation-capable flows.

rules.name: Determinism
rules.description: Equivalent inputs must produce equivalent diagnostics, classification, recovery category, and plan shape.

rules.name: ASH-Built Artifact Surface
rules.description: Observation, intent, encoding, evidence, actuator, repair, policy, and fixture artifacts must be current ASH Pattern System downstream specifications.

rules.name: Repository Scope
rules.description: This repository contains conformance specs/contracts/algorithms/interfaces/acceptance/CI and does not define platform build systems or shipped runtime binaries.

repo_contains: specs/algorithms/ - downstream authoritative orchestration and execution algorithms
repo_does_not_contain: Any artifact defining semantic truth outside the ASH Pattern System
